## History

John Selwyn came out from the Old Country to teach school at the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen), having a great-great-grandmother who was burned as a witch. During his time there, he boarded at Captain Jim's father's house and became close friends with Captain Jim, despite being ten years his senior.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P5](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P10](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0010)_

### [Persis Leigh](../character/persis-leigh.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/john-selwyn--persis-leigh.md)
